why_ai: Screen-based game production and paid testing, as AI cuts the cost of building and tuning games.
why_clarity: Retention and revenue are measured, but hit-making runs on folklore thresholds and taste.
why_digital: Code and media built on screens, distributed through app stores worldwide.

why_ai: Predicting 180-day outcomes from existing telemetry is a pure modelling task.
why_clarity: The prediction target is defined, but the true 180-day outcome arrives months later.
why_digital: Player telemetry in, predictions out, all inside the publisher's data stack.

why_ai: Signing a studio rests on a partner manager's read of people and per-relationship deal terms.
why_clarity: Each deal is negotiated differently and whether it produced a hit shows a year or more later.
why_digital: Pitches and builds are digital and studios abroad are normal, with relationships built in person.

why_ai: Predicting how soft-launch metrics transfer across markets is a transfer-modelling problem.
why_clarity: Transfer is checkable only after global scale-up, on few games per year.
why_digital: Market-level metrics in, scaling predictions out.

why_ai: Joint optimisation of ad and purchase revenue is a measurement and optimisation problem for software.
why_clarity: Revenue is measurable, but no agreed method measures both streams together.
why_digital: In-game ad and purchase data in, configuration changes out.

why_ai: Choosing offers for players thousands of times a day is the most mechanical decision in the business.
why_clarity: The decision recurs constantly and conversion gives immediate, objective feedback.
why_digital: Player segments in, offers configured in a live operations tool.

why_ai: Rebuilding the same onboarding, analytics and pipelines per concept is what AI coding tools absorb.
why_clarity: Unit cost and time per testable build are clear, measurable targets.
why_digital: Code, templates and build pipelines produced entirely on screens.

why_ai: Kill decisions on three days of evidence are high-stakes, but prediction tools increasingly drive them.
why_clarity: Dozens of decisions a month, yet the rule is folklore and portfolio results show years later.
why_digital: Test campaign metrics in, continue or kill decisions out.

why_ai: Recovering outcomes for killed games needs deliberate experimental design and costly business choices, not models.
why_clarity: The missing outcomes were never observed, so correctness cannot be checked.
why_digital: Experiment design and portfolio data, all digital.

why_ai: Tuning is model-driven, with emerging regulatory exposure adding accountable human oversight.
why_clarity: Revenue is measured but whether a high spender is all right has no defined measure.
why_digital: Player spend data in, monetisation tuning out, all on screens.

why_ai: Three-week game prototypes are the kind of build that AI generation is rapidly cheapening.
why_clarity: A quick binary retention verdict, but no way to tell a good idea from good execution.
why_digital: Game code and art built on screens and tested through app stores.
